title: My indirect-control kingdom game has a free demo. Come break it.
author: AnywhereOk6003
selftext:
Whenever people around my age see my game, they think it's Age of Mythology.
    
    But aside from the medieval setting (and the fact that my 3D models are nowhere near as polished), the gameplay is completely different!
    The game now has a free demo available, so feel free to download it and give it a try!
    It's an indirect-control kingdom strategy game.
    
    You don't have to command your heroes directly. Instead, you focus on building your kingdom, managing its economy, and occasionally placing bounties. The heroes will take care of the rest on their own.
    The game is still in development, and I'd love to hear your feedback! If you run into any bugs, please feel free to report them.
    
    Game Demo:
    https://store.steampowered.com/app/4610750/Wayward_Crown_Demo
    
    Game Wiki:
    https://jeffreychen-steamprojects.github.io/WaywardCrownWiki/

comments.author: the_masked_one_1234
comments.body: Hey! Is this like age of empires?

replies.author: AnywhereOk6003
replies.body: No, it's not like Age of Empires. You play as the ruler of a kingdom rather than directly controlling units. All units have their own AI and decide what tasks to do on their own. Your role is to manage the economy, oversee construction, and assign objectives and jobs to keep the kingdom running efficiently.
